query: LTX-2.3 videos degraded to muddy, structureless output after dependency churn; intermittent 'ghost' recovery. Root cause: running without the required distill LoRA and with xformers installed (should not be used with these nodes).

desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
